description: An African oasis in the green heart of Brussels. A unique place where professionals from different continents can work, work in team, reside and collaborate.
long_description: Kifaru is a place of inspiration where conviviality, work and the discovery of new horizons take centre stage.Kifaru means ‘rhino’ in Swahili. A rare icon of the African savannah and an honoured member of the Big Five. Like the rhino, the soul of Kifaru Tech & Bed is unique.African visitors feel at home, and Europeans take a relaxing African bath. Kifaru breathes Africa. We leave nothing to chance. It is a unique meeting place where state-of-the-art technology is combined with a comfortable bed. Small in size, but big in satisfaction.The elegant workspace and meeting rooms provide tranquillity through natural materials and durable furniture. African art embellishes our hub.
background_story: Debbie and Olivier are the inspirers of the project with Kifaru Brussels being the first development. A love couple who are at home with Desmond Tutu and adventurers at heart.Together with their offspring, they commute between Mombasa, Brussels and the world. The thread running through their activities is facilitating self-development for those who have the least access to it. One of the ways they do this is by closing the digital gap and providing computer classes in places where this is the last priority. Social entrepreneurship while scouting for talent in the least accessible areas of Africa and the world.In Kenya, for example, they have created a window on the world with a one-stop shop that helps young people turn their ideas into reality.Kifaru is therefore intended to be, on the one hand, the pied-à-terre for that burgeoning overseas talent. This way, they get to know the capital of Europe in an accessible way. On the other hand, Kifaru is also a bustling HUB for the indigenous population of Brussels.

reviews.author: Sarah Johnson
reviews.comment: Absolutely stunning property! The views were breathtaking and the amenities exceeded our expectations. The host was incredibly responsive and helpful. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a peaceful getaway.

response.author: Property Manager
response.text: Thank you so much for your kind words, Sarah! We're thrilled you enjoyed your stay and hope to welcome you back soon.

reviews.author: Michael Chen
reviews.comment: Perfect location for a family vacation. The property was spotless, well-maintained, and had everything we needed. The beach access was fantastic and the kids loved the pool. Great communication from the host throughout.

name: Ocean Kifaru North-Sea
description: Urban sophistication meets African elegance in the heart of Brussels' historic center.
long_description: Kifaru Brussels epitomizes urban luxury with an African soul. Located steps from the Grand Palace, our boutique hotel offers panoramic city views from stylish suites adorned with contemporary African art. Experience Michelin-starred dining with African-Belgian fusion cuisine, personalized shopping experiences in the luxury district, and exclusive access to cultural landmarks. Our executive suites feature state-of-the-art technology and bespoke service for the discerning traveler.

reviews.author: Emma Williams
reviews.comment: Beautiful property with amazing sunset views. The only minor issue was that the WiFi could be stronger in some rooms, but overall it was a wonderful experience. The kitchen was well-equipped and the outdoor spaces were perfect for relaxing.

name: Kifaru Msambweni
description: Exclusive beachfront sanctuary with direct coral reef access on Kenya's pristine south coast.
long_description: Kifaru Msambweni offers an unparalleled beachfront experience on Kenya's untouched south coast. Our private villas feature direct access to one of Africa's most vibrant coral reefs, perfect for snorkeling and diving enthusiasts. Enjoy fresh seafood at our beach grill, embark on traditional dhow sunset cruises, or experience deep-sea fishing adventures. Each villa includes a private infinity pool, outdoor shower, and panoramic Indian Ocean views, creating the ultimate coastal retreat.

reviews.author: David Martinez
reviews.comment: This place is a hidden gem! The photos don't do it justice. Everything was exactly as described and more. The host went above and beyond to make our stay comfortable. Already planning our next visit!

name: Kifaru Nairobi
description: Urban wildlife sanctuary offering sophisticated comfort with easy access to Nairobi's premier attractions.
long_description: Kifaru Nairobi Heights redefines urban safari living in the prestigious Karen neighborhood. Our property borders a private nature reserve, offering unparalleled wildlife viewing just minutes from the city center. Enjoy our rooftop restaurant with 360-degree views, organize seamless safari transfers to nearby national parks, and host events in our state-of-the-art conference center. Each suite features contemporary African design, private balconies, and modern amenities for both business and leisure travelers.

name: Kifaru Netherlands
description: Historic canal house transformed into a cultural haven where Dutch heritage embraces African warmth.
long_description: Kifaru Netherlands Villa offers a unique cultural immersion in a meticulously restored 17th-century canal house. Experience authentic Dutch living with African-inspired hospitality, from cycling through vibrant tulip fields to private canal tours on our classic boat. Participate in traditional Dutch art workshops with African influences, savor innovative Dutch-African fusion cuisine, and relax in our wellness center featuring both European spa treatments and African healing rituals. This is where two rich cultures harmoniously converge.

reviews.author: Lisa Anderson
reviews.comment: Exceptional property in every way. Clean, comfortable, and beautifully decorated. The location is perfect - close to town but still feels private and peaceful. Highly recommend!

name: Kifaru Nyali
description: Vibrant beach resort offering family-friendly luxury with authentic Swahili coastal experiences.
long_description: Kifaru Nyali Resort captures the vibrant spirit of Kenya's coast with premium family-friendly amenities. Our expansive beach club features multiple pools, water sports, and dedicated kids' activities. Enjoy privileged access to championship golf courses, state-of-the-art fitness facilities, and authentic Swahili cultural experiences. Savor coastal fusion cuisine at our beachfront restaurants, enjoy nightly entertainment showcasing local talent, and create unforgettable family memories in our spacious suites designed for multi-generational travel.
